title: Hybrid AI Patterns: Thirteen Ways to Couple Language Models with Rules, and How to Choose Among Them
abstract: arXiv:2610.40036v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models handle text well, and rule engines give conclusions with proofs. Systems that combine the two are usually described by example, and the same coupling turns up under different names in agent frameworks, guardrail toolkits and neuro-symbolic research. This document defines thirteen patterns for coupling a language model with an executable rule language, in the catalogue form introduced for object-oriented design: intent, motivation, applicability, participants, collaborations, consequences, implementation, known uses and related patterns. Four patterns concern what crosses the boundary between model and rules, five who controls whom, three how the model takes part in the reasoning, and one how knowledge is kept over time. Five invariants hold for every combination, and five failure patterns name the couplings that break them. We relate the catalogue to published pattern catalogues and taxonomies of hybrid and neuro-symbolic

translated_title: 混合人工智能模式：语言模型与规则耦合的十三种方式及其选择方法
translated_abstract: 语言模型擅长处理文本，而规则引擎能给出带有证明的结论。将两者结合的系统通常仅以示例方式描述，且相同的耦合方式在智能体框架、护栏工具包和神经符号研究中以不同名称反复出现。本文以面向对象设计所采用的目录形式（包括意图、动机、适用性、参与者、协作、后果、实现、已知用途和相关模式），定义了语言模型与可执行规则语言耦合的十三种模式。其中四种模式关注跨越模型与规则边界的内容，五种关注谁控制谁，三种关注模型如何参与推理，一种关注知识如何随时间保存。五种不变式对所有组合均成立，五种失败模式则指出了破坏这些不变式的耦合方式。我们将该目录与已发表的模式目录以及混合智能和神经符号研究的分类体系进行了关联。
tldr: 本文系统梳理了语言模型与规则引擎耦合的十三种设计模式，并提出五种不变式与五种失败模式，指导开发者根据需求选择合适的耦合方式。
en_tdlr: This paper catalogs thirteen design patterns for coupling language models with rule engines, and provides five invariants and five failure patterns to guide developers in choosing among them.
